{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p50","kind":"meal","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Order the mì Quảng (turmeric noodles with pork, shrimp and a sesame cracker) and watch the broth do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p57","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Long stretch of sand with a slow, easy rhythm; perfect for a barefoot wander and a long look at the bay."},{"poi_id":"p81","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Coconut cream in a cup, cold enough to make you forget the heat for twenty minutes."},{"poi_id":"p111","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Fermented fish broth with noodles, bold and briny; a proper local bowl near the centre."},{"poi_id":"p49","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Sit-down Vietnamese plates with a river breeze; the kind of dinner that stretches past one course."}]}
